## SECOND SCHEDULE
# second-schedule
LIST SHOWING QUANTITIES TO BE ENTERED FOR EACH COMMODITY CODE
List showing which denominations of quantity and/or units of measurement, are to be entered for goods being imported in, or exported from, Malta, depending on their classification according to the Harmonised System Code. Against each code the net and gross weight in kilos are to be entered.
